description: The conformance corpus. Every loader and validator runs these: valid files must load, invalid ones must be refused with the named code. Warnings are advisory and listed so validators agree on them.

codes.version: version missing, not an integer, or newer than 1
codes.schema: structure the schema rejects: a missing field, a wrong type, a reserved or unknown kind
codes.ref.token: a shape names a token that neither the local palette nor any palette_ref could supply
codes.ref.part: a state names a part the document does not have
codes.tris: tris is not index triples, or an index is past the last point
codes.dup.token: two local tokens share a name
codes.ref.parent: a part names a parent the document does not have
codes.clip: a clip with no keys, keys out of order, or a key with neither or both of state and parts
codes.ref.state: a clip key names a state the document does not have
codes.chain: a constraint's chain is empty or its parts are not parented in order
codes.ref.anchor: a constraint's end is not part/anchor on the chain's last part
codes.like: a part is like itself, like a part that is itself like another, or carries its own shapes or anchors
codes.ref.chain: a target names a constraint the document does not have
codes.space: a space the reader does not know (1.3)
codes.face: a mesh face with fewer than three indices, or an index past the last point (1.3)
codes.convex: a collision mesh is not convex: a point lies in front of the named face (1.4)
codes.ref.texture: a shape names a texture the document does not have (1.5)

warnings.unknown: an unknown field, preserved but meaningless to this version
warnings.reserved: a field or value this version reserves for later (children)
warnings.unresolved: a palette_ref or a texture map's ref could not be read, so what it supplies was not checked

shart_codes.version: version missing, not an integer, or newer than 1
shart_codes.schema: structure the schema rejects, or attach where it cannot apply
shart_codes.path: an absolute ref, palette or palette_ref
shart_codes.space: a space the reader does not know, or a ref of the other space
shart_codes.ref.state: the referenced file lacks the state
shart_codes.ref.clip: the referenced file lacks the clip
shart_codes.ref.anchor: the referenced file lacks the anchor
